title: FieldThrow-Arc — Open-Field Dancefloor + 45 m Long-Range Throw
description: Designed for open-field gatherings needing both high-impact front dancefloor coverage (6–20 m) and coherent long-range projection out to 45 m — comparing a 6-Sub Coupled Electronic Arc against classic spaced L/R sub stacks.
design_notes: Eliminating the 'Power Alley': Separating Left & Right sub stacks by 10.4 m (Variant B) creates a narrow +6 dB center bass beam flanked by deep -15 dB cancellation fingers across the field. Centering all 6 subs at 0.62 m spacing (< lambda/4) with parabolic 75° Electronic-Arc delays (Variant A) creates one seamless, lobe-free 75° bass fan out to 45 m!

Dual-Splay Vertical Shading for Range: Stacking an upper Long-Throw Synergy top (+3 dB, -2.2° tilt aimed at 35 m) over a padded Near-Fill top (-2.5 dB, -9° tilt aimed at 10 m) counteracts inverse-square distance loss so front-row dancers aren't deafened while 40 m listeners still get crisp HF/mid clarity (compensating ISO 9613-1 air + turf absorption).
